description:
Redwood Inference will deliver a “hardware tuning profiles pack” for the serving runtime focused on kernel + scheduling performance across the current and near-future NVIDIA fleet (H100, B200, L40S). The goal is to provide curated, versioned runtime configuration profiles (e.g., scheduler/batching knobs, kernel-selection toggles, memory/KV-cache settings, NCCL/collectives tuning where applicable, CPU-side runtime settings) that are safe-by-default, measurable, and easy to roll out in Hosted, Dedicated, and Private environments. The project includes (1) defining a profile schema and compatibility/guardrails, (2) establishing baseline performance and representative workloads, (3) implementing and validating hardware-specific tuned configs, (4) documenting expected behavior and failure modes, and (5) releasing the pack with regression detection and a rollback plan.

Scope:
- In-scope: runtime config schema + loader; kernel auto-selection heuristics per GPU SKU; scheduler parameter presets (continuous batching, prefill/decode fairness, backpressure, queue limits); KV cache memory behavior presets; perf/benchmark harness updates; canary and regression gates; docs describing “expected behavior” (latency/throughput curves, workload assumptions, known trade-offs).
- Out-of-scope (initial): new kernels from scratch; major API surface changes; customer-specific bespoke tuning (handled via Solutions/Support as follow-ups).

Stakeholders and owners:
- Primary Eng: Runtime Kernels (Hiro Tanaka, Grace Kim, Yuki Sato, Isabella Rossi) and Runtime Scheduling (Sofia Ivanova, Lena Fischer, Marcus Reed).
- Performance/Benchmarks: Rina Kobayashi, Claire Dubois.
- Infra/Fleet and rollout: Irene Choi, Vanessa Ortiz, Keiko Yamamoto, Nina Petrova.
- SRE/operational guardrails: Neha Kapoor org; coordination via eng-sre and eng-oncall.
- Applied ML reviewers for model/profile interactions (quantization + workload realism): Maya Srinivasan org; Arjun Desai, Jonas Weber.

Timeline (illustrative, ~8–10 weeks):
1) Kickoff + requirements (week 1): define target SKUs, fleet variance, safety constraints, acceptance metrics.
2) Baselines (weeks 1–2): establish benchmark suite + workload matrix; collect baseline curves per GPU.
3) Profile schema + implementation (weeks 2–5): config pack format, runtime loader, and initial presets.
4) Validation + canary rollout (weeks 5–8): perf-canary gates, staged rollout by region/pool, regression triage.
5) Documentation + release (weeks 7–10): Confluence reference + runbooks + release notes; internal training for SRE/CS.

Key deliverables:
- Versioned profile pack (H100/B200/L40S) integrated into runtime config and deployment tooling.
- Benchmark report and methodology, plus “expected behavior” documentation (what improves, what regresses, and why).
- Rollout/rollback and operational guidance (alerts, dashboards, safe toggles, troubleshooting).
- Regression detection in perf canary and CI.

Constraints and risks:
- Hardware variance (HBM size, clocks, MIG/partitioning, PCIe vs SXM, network topology) must be accounted for via guardrails.
- Scheduler and kernel settings can improve throughput while harming tail latency; profiles must specify the intended workload envelope.
- B200 enablement may require rapid iteration with partial fleet access; documentation must be explicit about maturity level and fallbacks.

Fit within Redwood context:
These profiles power Redwood’s differentiators in predictable serving economics and “Redwood-verified performance profiles” for the model catalog. They also reduce incident volume from mis-tuned runtime settings and create a repeatable process for bringing up new GPU generations.

files.description: Project overview page: goals, non-goals, target GPU SKUs (H100/B200/L40S), success metrics (p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost), owners, and milestone plan.
Design doc for the tuning profile schema: versioning, inheritance, hardware detection, guardrails, and compatibility with runtime releases and deployment modes.
ADR describing how profiles are shipped (baked into runtime vs external bundle), how overrides work (fleet defaults vs per-pool vs per-customer), and rollback semantics.
Benchmark methodology and workload matrix (sequence length distributions, concurrency, model families, streaming vs non-streaming) used to validate each hardware profile.
Reference doc for H100 profile: key knobs, expected performance deltas, recommended use cases, and known trade-offs (throughput vs tail latency).
Reference doc for B200 profile: maturity level, required driver/CUDA assumptions, kernel-selection differences vs H100, and explicit fallback plan.
Reference doc for L40S profile: memory constraints, recommended batch/queue defaults, and guidance for cost-sensitive workloads.
Operational runbook: staged rollout steps by pool/region, required dashboards, alert thresholds, rollback steps, and incident response playbook for regressions.
Documentation of perf-canary gates and dashboards used for pre-merge and post-deploy validation; includes which metrics must remain within bounds per profile.
Living list of known issues: pathological prompt distributions, memory fragmentation patterns, kernel mismatches, and mitigations/feature flags.
Epic ticket tracking the initiative: scope, milestones, sub-issues, risk register, and links to Confluence docs/benchmarks/PRs.
Ticket for schema definition, config validation, and versioning; includes acceptance criteria and review checklist.
Ticket for implementing the runtime loader and precedence rules (env vars, config files, fleet defaults); includes rollout and backward compatibility plan.
Ticket for H100 preset: scheduler defaults, kernel-selection toggles, and perf targets; links to benchmark results and PRs.
Ticket for L40S preset focused on memory/KV cache limits and safe batching; includes regression checks for OOM/latency spikes.
Ticket for B200 early enablement: assumptions, required software stack versions, and initial tuning knobs; marked high risk with staged validation.
Ticket for perf suite updates: workload matrix codification, dataset/prompt set pins, and reproducible harness scripts.
Ticket to add/adjust perf-canary gates and alerting thresholds specific to profile rollouts; includes sign-off from SRE.
Ticket to produce the “expected behavior” docs (latency/throughput curves, what improves/regresses, safe operating envelope).
Ticket for release readiness: checklist, comms to oncall/SRE, rollback criteria, and final sign-offs.
PR adding the profile schema, JSON validation, and unit tests; includes documentation in-code for supported keys and deprecation strategy.
PR implementing hardware detection and profile selection logic (with explicit override order), plus safe fallbacks when detection is ambiguous.
PR introducing H100 scheduler presets (balanced vs throughput-first) with guardrails for tail latency; includes before/after perf summaries.
PR adjusting kernel-selection heuristics for H100 by sequence-length buckets; includes microbench references and perf-canary links.
PR adding L40S-focused KV cache budgeting defaults and OOM-prevention guardrails; includes runtime logs and rollback toggle.
PR introducing B200 profile behind an experimental feature flag; includes explicit version checks and compatibility notes.
PR adding a benchmark runner that enumerates the workload matrix across GPU SKUs and produces a standardized summary artifact.
PR adding/adjusting perf-canary thresholds and regression detection specific to profile-enabled builds; includes alert routing changes.
PR adding metrics for selected profile, override source, and key knob values; includes a debug endpoint for oncall triage.
PR fixing a regression discovered during H100 profile validation; includes discussion of trade-offs and added regression test.
PR wiring profile pack configuration into Helm values for Dedicated/Private; documents override order and safe defaults.
PR adding public-ish internal docs pages (or internal docs site) describing profile usage, expectations, and troubleshooting.
PR logging runtime version + profile version compatibility matrix at startup; aimed at reducing misconfiguration in Private deployments.
PR adding integration tests verifying override precedence (fleet default vs per-deployment vs per-route) and safe fallback behavior.
PR refactoring default handling to avoid “drift” between profile pack and runtime hard-coded defaults; includes migration notes.
Hotfix PR to disable B200 experimental profile in a specific pool/region after a canary regression; includes incident linkage.
PR adding a CLI/tooling command to print the effective runtime config after profile selection and overrides; helps Support/SRE.
PR updating dashboards to segment latency/throughput by selected hardware profile and to highlight tail-latency regressions during rollout.
Thread coordinating kickoff: owners, initial scope, and where the draft schema doc lives; quick consensus on H100/L40S first, B200 gated.
Thread debating which scheduler/kernel knobs are safe to pin in a profile vs left adaptive; includes notes from Scheduling and Kernels leads.
Thread sharing first benchmark deltas for H100 preset, with follow-up questions about tail latency and streaming stability.
Thread triaging L40S OOMs during perf suite runs; includes proposed KV cache budgeting and memory guardrail changes.
Thread with Infra + Runtime about limited B200 fleet access, required driver/CUDA versions, and how to gate experimental profiles.
Thread enumerating GPU SKU string variants from different providers/instance types and how detection logic should normalize them.
Thread where SRE requests concrete rollback thresholds, dashboard links, and how oncall can quickly disable profiles per pool.
Thread reviewing the ADR for distribution/override order; includes nitpicks on precedence and config drift risks.
Thread discussing edge cases: MIG partitions, multi-GPU nodes, and whether profiles should apply per-device or per-node.
Thread investigating a p95 regression after enabling the H100 preset; includes logs, hypotheses, and next steps leading to a fix PR.
Thread coordinating release branch targeting, backport strategy, and whether to ship profiles in runtime-1.x vs behind flags.
Thread aligning on wording: “expected behavior” vs contractual guarantees, and how to describe trade-offs without overpromising.
Thread about tuning perf-canary gates to reduce noise/false positives while still catching regressions during profile changes.
Thread during a canary incident: decision to disable B200 experimental profile in a pool, status updates, and follow-up action items.
Thread with Applied ML requesting workload realism in the benchmark suite (prompt length mix, tool-calling patterns, streaming).
Thread aligning on how Private customers can override profiles safely via Helm values without breaking supportability.
Thread requesting and reviewing new metrics to expose selected profile + overrides; includes naming conventions for dashboards.
Thread drafting oncall triage steps: what toggles to flip, what dashboards to check, and what logs to collect.
Working doc: kickoff notes, open questions, list of candidate knobs, and early hypotheses on H100 vs L40S differences.
Draft workload matrix (informal) with proposed model families, sequence buckets, concurrency levels, and pass/fail criteria.
Spreadsheet-style doc: baseline vs tuned metrics for H100 across workloads (p50/p95, tokens/sec, GPU mem, retries), plus notes.
Experiment log doc for L40S: KV cache sizing attempts, fragmentation observations, OOM repro steps, and proposed guardrails.
Checklist for B200 bring-up: software stack versions, driver/CUDA requirements, microbench sanity checks, gating and rollback.
Release checklist and comms draft: who signs off, what dashboards must be green, and how to communicate changes to oncall/support.
SRE working doc: monitoring plan, alert thresholds, and operational readiness items for staged rollout by pool/region.
Slides text export: executive readout on perf gains, risks, rollout plan, and how this supports Redwood’s performance positioning.
Support ticket capturing a customer-reported latency spike correlated with profile rollout; includes investigation notes, mitigation, and links to dashboards/PRs.
Support ticket: Private customer asks how to override hardware profile safely; includes pointers to Helm values and runbook guidance.
Internal support ticket about flaky perf-canary runners on L40S; includes CI logs, infra hypotheses, and remediation steps.
Transcript of a technical deep dive with NVIDIA/partner contacts: B200 bring-up, recommended tuning areas, driver stack notes, and follow-ups.
Internal weekly sync transcript: status across Kernels/Scheduling/Infra, benchmark results review, blockers, and next steps.
Email thread between Infra/SRE/Runtime leadership on rollout risk, canary criteria, and oncall readiness requirements (with links to runbooks/dashboards).
Leadership thread approving B200 experimental gating approach, timeline constraints, and expectations for documentation/rollback.
CRM company record for a prospect evaluating Dedicated H100 capacity with strict latency SLOs; notes reference Redwood’s hardware profiles and requested benchmark evidence.
CRM record for an enterprise/security-sensitive prospect considering Private deployment; notes include questions about profile overrides, observability, and operational guardrails.
